title: eriogonum coryphaeum
intro: Eriogonum coryphaeum, commonly known as Desert Buckwheat, is a flowering plant native to the western United States. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Desert Buckwheat include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and supporting digestive health. The bioactive constituents of Eriogonum coryphaeum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
